name: Bad to the Bone
source:
Life is totally unpredictable. You can plan it, but it often takes you some place you never dreamed of. Will you still be daddy and mommy's princess or will you taste the forbidden fruit too?

[From in-app]
translation:
生活是完全不可预测的。你可以计划它，但它常常会把你带到你从未梦想过的地方。你仍然会是爸爸和妈妈的公主，还是也会尝到禁果？

[来自应用程序内]
